name: openqodex
description: Open source AI code review for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Cline, before you push. Scanners (SAST, secrets, dependencies, lint) on the lines you changed, then a review on your agent's own model. No API key.

interface.longDescription: OpenQodex is open source AI code review that runs inside Codex before you push. It runs the scanners that fit your change (Semgrep, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner, ShellCheck, Ruff and more) on the lines you changed for security vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, vulnerable dependencies and lint errors. Codex then reviews the change on its own model and writes its findings in a fixed format, and a final step with no model checks each finding's format, whether it sits on a changed line, and any scanner it cites. No API key, no account, no telemetry. Apache 2.0.
defaultPrompt: Review my change with openqodex before I push
Run a security scan on my uncommitted changes
Review the whole repo with openqodex
